name: NOAA MarineCadastre Long Beach traffic aggregates (2024-01-10)

source.provider: BOEM, NOAA Office for Coastal Management, U.S. Coast Guard
source.license_note: Derived from U.S. Coast Guard NAIS and free for public use; U.S. Government material is not subject to U.S. copyright. Foreign copyrights may apply.
source.use_limitation: Intended for coastal and ocean planning; not adequate for regulatory or enforcement use.

field_mapping.vessel_count: unique MMSI count; identities are discarded
field_mapping.stopped_ratio: fraction of messages with SOG below 0.5 knots
field_mapping.course_dispersion: one minus circular resultant length of COG
field_mapping.traffic_density: vessel_count divided by in-dataset 95th percentile, clipped to one
field_mapping.position_spread_km: two-dimensional standard deviation of positions in kilometres

environment.counterfactual_note: AIS contains historical observations, not intervention outcomes. Action response coefficients are explicit sandbox assumptions and must be calibrated with port telemetry before site acceptance.
